Zoe: FYI  spotted a large token spike on account LUMA-501 during onboarding. Budget alert fired at 02:22 UTC. Need a crisp QBR summary + immediate playbook. :warning:
Arun: grabbing dashboard now: https://console.redwood/clients/luma/spend  daily tokens ~2.05M, projected monthly ~61M. Looks like a bulk embeddings import.
Mei: CS ticket shows they uploaded full transcripts with default pipeline. No chunking or dedupe applied. I'll ask for the import manifest.
Carlos: quick triage checklist we've used before:
```
- pause new ingestion jobs > 100k records
- enable embedding batching (batch_size=128)
- run hash-based dedupe on import set
- enable prefix caching for repeated metadata
- apply a temporary throttle (50%) as fallback
```
OpsBot: [budget-alert] LUMA-501 threshold breached. today_tokens=2,048,721 projected_month=61,461,630. Trigger=embed-bulk-ingest. Suggested actions: notify-cs, temp-throttle, escalate FinOps.
Zoe: For the QBR deck please prepare three scenarios (tokens + USD):
- mitigated: dedupe + batching + throttle
- partial: batching + quantize non-prod endpoints
- baseline: no changes
Include a one-line recommendation and adoption sensitivity (25/50/100%).
FinOpsBot: Acknowledged. Will post token->USD conversions and the three scenario rows by COB tomorrow. Will include per-seat renewal impact.
Arun: SQL I use to break down route-level spend for slides:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='LUMA-501' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Mei: I'll schedule a 30-min enablement with their eng lead tomorrow 10am PT to demo Optimize presets and walk through dedupe/chunking. I'll include a short checklist and ask them to opt-in to the temporary throttle: reply 'THROTTLE OK' to accept immediate relief.
Carlos: Draft customer note (short):
"Hi Luma team  we noticed a large import increasing token usage. We can run a 30-min session to enable batching, dedupe, and Optimize presets. We can also enable a temporary throttle until changes are live. Reply 'THROTTLE OK' to accept".
Zoe: Mike from FinOps asked for a single-line QBR takeaway we can paste: "Bulk onboarding import caused an embeddings spike; mitigations estimate 3065% monthly token reduction depending on adoption." Feel free to tweak.
FinOpsBot: Uploaded preliminary conversion rates and sensitivity model to /shared/qbrs/luma. Will finalize numbers after the enablement and any throttle acceptance.
Arun: Can Ops create a budget rule we can flip on? Suggest pause ingestion when daily tokens > 2,500,000; fallback throttle 50%.
OpsBot: [action_created] budget_rule/luma-temp-cap-230123 by Arun. Rule: pause ingestion when daily_tokens > 2,500,000; fallback_throttle=50%; notify=@customer-success.
Mei: I'll capture any doc friction or feature asks during the session and paste short quotes for the QBR renewal slide. Note to self: check if their pipeline can emit pre-ingest size estimates; if not, add as an action item.
Zoe: Thanks team. Quick ask: capture whether customer accepts throttle and whether they adopt Optimize presets within 7 days  that will determine renewal risk color for the QBR (green/amber/red). I'll stitch the final QBR slide after your notes. :thumbsup:
